beliefs: With all controls at minimum and switch off, the dot is at (0,0) with size 1.0 [E1]
Dial a moves the dot in x and increases size: x=2a and size=1+0.5a [E3]
Dial b moves the dot in x negatively: x=-b, size unchanged [E4]
Dial c moves the dot in y and increases size: y=c and size=1+0.5c [E5]
Switch on with all dials at minimum moves the dot to y=10, leaving x and size unchanged [E2]
Switch on with c>0: y = 10 - c (E6: c=5→5, E7: c=3→7, E8: c=8→2), i.e. the switch reflects c about 5 [E2,E6,E7,E8]
So switch on gives y = 10 - c for all c in [0,10], matching y=10 at c=0 [E2,E6,E7,E8]
How a and c combine on size (additive vs max) is still unknown? [E3,E5]
notes: E8 (c=8, switch on → y=2) shows the switch reflects c about 5 for all c, not max(c,10-c); replaced that rule with y=10-c when switch is on. Size stays additive 1+0.5a+0.5c, which fits all data so far.
